Can Gandhi and Ambedkar's legacies come together in today's politics? In this episode of Express DeshKaal, Yogendra Yadav discusses Gandhi's evolving views on caste, the political appropriation of Ambedkar, the legacy of Lohia and the relevance of Gandhian protest movements today.
The Indian Express brings you comprehensive coverage of global & indian politics, election news, business news, world affairs, sports, entertainment, Bollywood, and public policy.
